source.version: Part 17 — Integrated Pest Management, Biosecurity, and Sanitation — Batch 01
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-09-01. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-321–325 open Volume 17 with current EPA IPM principles; hemp-specific clone/transplant quarantine guidance; current greenhouse zoning, sanitation, personnel, stock-plant, and propagation-risk guidance; and direct Cannabis HLVd mechanical-transmission evidence. Public wording separates prevention from control, risk pathways from demonstrated transmission, visual health from pathogen-free status, and cleaning from disinfection while preserving current label and jurisdiction boundaries.
source.note: This batch opens controlled Volume 17 with IPM principles, clean-to-dirty zoning, plant intake/quarantine, personnel entry/clothing controls, and tool/bench/container sanitation.
